messages:
nina: Heads-up — I'm reworking the quickstart 'Hello Mini' to reduce steps for auth + first deploy. Pushing a WIP PR in ~30m. Need someone to sanity-check Node snippets and the Docker part.

paul: nice. can you outline the breaking changes? worried about the env var rename.

jorge: I can take Node snippets. which SDK version are we surfacing? SDK8 or include SDK7 fallback?

nina: primary SDK8. also add one-liner for SDK7 compatibility. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 (WIP).

sam: can we add a minimal Dockerfile + how to forward creds? people keep stuffing tokens into images.

paul: agree. recommend using build-time ARGs + env injection at runtime. also rename token var to REDWOOD_API_KEY (consistency with console).

jorge: on the Node example, we now call createClient({ auth: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY }) instead of passing token string. i'll paste a short snippet.

jorge: ```js
const { createClient } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = createClient({ auth: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt: 'hi' });
console.log(res.text);
```

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck failed for /quickstart/hello-mini — missing redirect, 404 on /sdk7-compat. Full log: ERROR 404 - /sdk7-compat (line 12).

nina: thanks. i'll add a redirect and a note in PR. @jorge can you add the SDK7 one-liner under 'compat' section?

jorge: yep, will add a short appendix and update the snippet. also will rename the example env var across samples.

paul: i'll spin up a smoke deploy and test the Docker instruction later tonight. ping me when PR is ready for review.

sam: add a one-sentence callout about Dedicated/Private deployments: 'If you're running on Dedicated/Private, use internal endpoints and KMS for keys' — trivial but prevents support tickets.

nina: good call. i'll add that and update the checklist. thanks all :rocket:
